Inherited checkpoint: `bootstrap_variant_0096_cyl_ms_s1to9_long_from94/checkpoints/online_4000`. Hypothesis: Pin the cold reset to one path. At every prefix state from 1 on, the 0096 online_4000 actor is within 0.02-0.2 of the recorded control of the short sources, but at the cold reset it is 1.4-2.0 from every source first control: the cold reset is the one state all training sources share and their first controls differ, so the actor regresses toward their mean. The 8-control source seed_172 becomes the spine: every one of its rows is a supervised, per-state pinned row (actor_bc_shared_lambda 50; the other sources first-control rows are excluded from BC by the shared-state rule), 40 % of the episodes hand off at its prefixes 0-4 (weights 2:2:1:1:1) and the rest keep the long-weighted suffix stream over all 54 sources; evaluated on the three shortest sources, the held-out trio and the cold reset at every checkpoint. Success criterion unchanged: a frozen cold-reset turn.

Stage status `complete_sac_stage` (?, 1192 s loop); final learner counters {'bc_updates': 12000, 'pretrain_updates': 8000, 'online_updates': 46250}; 500 critic-pretraining and 4000 online updates as prescribed. Temperature: learned from the inherited value. Actor step: overridden to 0.0001 for this stage (inherited 0.0001; ramp fraction unchanged). Supervision: lambda * MSE(actor mean(obs), atanh(clip(action, +-(1 - .02)))) over the last 8 rows of each demonstration episode plus its shared cold-start prefix rows; additionally, per distinct shared state, lambda_shared 50.0 * (MSE of the actor mean to the label + MSE of the log-std to log(std target)) summed over the distinct shared states (one term per state, however many sources sit on it), added to the single SAC actor step; spread anchor: lambda_std * MSE(actor log-std at the supervised rows, log(0.01)) added to the same actor step. Handoff noise: off.

## Large-sample frozen evaluation (30 fresh-seed stochastic trials per prefix; D = deterministic pass)

The 30-trial results are in the campaign section below.

## Cylinder campaign, seed_172 as a spine with shared cold-start prefixes (`0099`, from `0096` online_4000, 4,000 updates): 30-trial frozen evaluation

Environment: the archived task with `object_shape: circular` (40 mm). Recipe: the lengths-1-9 weighted suffix stream of `0096` over the 51 training sources for 60 % of the episodes; the other 40 % start from the state after 0-4 recorded controls of seed_172 (weights 2:2:1:1:1; `start_prefix_set`, `spine_source`), every row of seed_172 is a per-state supervised row (`actor_bc_shared_lambda` 50) and the other sources' rows at the cold reset are excluded from supervision by the shared-state rule, so the cold reset has one label, seed_172's first control. Evaluated: seed_172 (8 controls), seed_116 (9), seed_174 (9), the held-out seeds 153, 154, 155, and the shared cells k0-k4 (the cold reset and the states after 1-4 recorded controls of seed_172, 30 stochastic trials plus one deterministic each, `results_shared/`). Start checkpoint `0096` online_4000 on seed_172: 30/30 D, 30/30 D, 30/30 D, 12/30, 7/30 D, 9/30 D, 0/30 at lengths 1-7.

Shared cells at online_4000: k0 (cold reset) 0/30, deterministic fail (every trial dropped the object at the second policy control, force-qualified angle 0.82-1.68 rad); k1 (after one recorded control, seven policy controls) 2/30, deterministic fail (the two successes used 4 and 7 policy controls); k2 (six policy controls) 6/30 D; k3 (five) 7/30; k4 (four) 22/30 D. The k1 and k2 states are the same states as seed_172's length-7 and length-6 cells (0/30 and 6/30 D above; different trial seeds and the shared-prefix replay path).

**Reading.** The spine supervision held the actor near seed_172's recorded controls at its recorded states: L2 between the deterministic action and the recorded control at the eight states is 0.02-0.07 from online_500 to online_3500 (`cylinder_first_control_0001/spine_residual_0099_seed_172.json`; at the start 1.70 at the cold reset and 0.02-0.15 elsewhere), and 0.15 at the cold reset at online_4000. With that residual the policy completes the turn from the state after seed_172's second recorded control (length 6: 6/30 D; k2 6/30 D) and in 2 of 30 stochastic trials from the state after its first (k1; `0095` online_3500 had 4/30 at the same state, seed_172 length 7, and every other cylinder checkpoint 0/30); from the cold reset itself 0/30 with a deterministic fail at every checkpoint (in-run F0/5 at all nine). The one training episode that succeeded from the cold reset (k0: 1 of 97 completed episodes; k1 0/90, k2 6/55, k3 11/48, k4 45/56) is changing-policy, stochastic data, not frozen-policy evidence. On seed_172 the last four controls reached 23/30 D (from 12/30 at the start, the campaign's highest length-4 cell on this source), the last five 8/30 and the last six 6/30 D (from 7/30 D and 9/30 D); seed_116 fell at length 3 (13/30 from 21/30 D) and seed_174 at length 2 (9/30 from 0/30, rising) and 3 (4/30 D from 11/30 D) with length 4 at 9/30 D (from 3/30). Held out: seed_153's last control 24/30 D (from 9/30 at the start), seed_154 and seed_155 0/30 throughout. Online stream by suffix length 1-9: 32/33, 31/44, 12/33, 15/76, 11/70, 4/73, 4/65, 3/66, 0/71 (changing-policy data). Against the hypothesis (pinning the cold reset to one path makes the actor's first control usable): the residual at the cold reset fell from 1.70 to 0.02-0.03 and the cold reset stayed at 0/30, which `cylinder_first_control_0001` explains: the first control of seed_172 tolerates open-loop perturbations of 1e-5 to 1e-6 (5 of 10 directions fail at r = 1e-6, 6 of 10 at 1e-5), two to three thousand times below the pinned residual, and a behaviour-cloned actor reproducing the eight controls to 1e-5 fails from the cold reset as well. No cold-reset trial succeeded; nothing here is primitive-eligible; the circular object is a disclosed deviation from the paper's hexagonal prism.

## Scope

All collected rows are assisted or demonstration-mixed and ineligible for primitive export; cold-reset trials decide deployment eligibility and none succeeded in this stage. Numbers above are read directly from the artifact files by `bootstrap_variant_template_0001/auto_findings.py`; interpretation is deferred to the family syntheses in `bootstrap_variant_template_0001/`.
